notes.title: 🔧 Demo Update – September 17, 2025
notes.content:
Gameplay & Balance
Added pushback effect on every rank of Ability: Charge.

Added feature: Melee monsters gain increased speed every 10 seconds to prevent players from endlessly outrunning enemies.

Added Auto Aim and Auto Attack feature.

Added directional arrow indicator for better visualization of where the player is aiming.
Abilities
Laser:

Distance reduced from 15 → 10.

Damage reduced from 4 → 2.

Max projectile count reduced from 8 → 6.

Small Rockets:

Maximum damage reduced from 30 → 20.

Reduced projectile count on all ranks.

Lightning Strike, Fire Strike, Poison Strike:

Now apply DoT effects starting from the first rank.
[hr][/hr]
This update applies to the demo version of the game.
Follow this page for more updates and wishlist the game to support us!

notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Major Update – Controller Support – September 10, 2025
notes.content:
Gameplay & Balance
Added support for controllers (game automatically detects if a controller is in use).

Increased camera distance from the player character.

Increased mining deposit capacity from 200 to 600.

Increased mining default speed from 20 to 50.

Added indicator of player character facing direction.

Improved player character visibility in the center of the screen.

Added in-game tutorial.

Performance
Improved performance for:

Enemy animations and rendering.

World rendering.

Hit VFX.

Materials.

Graphics & Audio
Updated Sector 1 environment (new textures, repainted several areas).

Updated enemy sounds.


Fixes
Escape button behavior in menu improved.

Fixed boss at the end of the level (all boss phases are now achievable).


[hr][/hr]


This update applies to the demo version of the game.

notes.title: PLAYTEST 0.2 – Ranked abilities, sharper style, deeper cuts
notes.content:
Hey! Time to jump back into action. Our first major update is here

And we’ve turned up the heat. Playtest 0.2 brings key improvements that give you more options, better combat feel, and some serious visual upgrades.


Ability Rank System
Not all elements are created equal — and not every mining run makes you a god.
Find out which ones are worth the grind and watch your power grow.
Loot planets, stack effects, and build something that actually shreds.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/edb05ab7ba5d3812dc5f553ec0f183f69f6dd82e.png"]


New Ship Visuals
Your base just got a glow-up.
New atmosphere, new details, a fresh coat of cosmic paint — come check out the latest in intergalactic interior design 😎


Updated Level Visuals
The world looks better than ever — more depth, more mood, more “oh no, this place is definitely hostile.”
Refreshed lighting and reworked environments are live.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/d3c0115409eccca5d425bccccce33c2d2e34d92d.png"]


Core Combat Stays – Fast, Fluid, and Tactical
The heart of the game is still there: fast-paced battles, responsive dodging, smart combos.
Slice through enemies, mine elements, craft compounds, and tweak your build to stay alive. Or not.
Boot it up and see how far you get.


💬 Tell Us What Hits and What Misses
This update was shaped by your feedback — thanks! And keep it coming. Join our Discord and let us know what hits, what needs love, and what made you yell “yo, that was sick.” 👉 Join our Discord


⭐ Wishlist = Fuel for the Journey
Excited for what’s next? Add the game to your wishlist and stay locked in for more updates.
It also helps us blast through the Steam algorithm galaxy.
👉 Wishlist Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor on Steam



Thanks for playing,

notes.title: PLAYTEST 0.1 – Slash, survive, welcome to the void
notes.content:
Hey there – this is not the one to skip.

The first public playtest of Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor is live — and you’re not here to stargaze. Dive headfirst into the massacre of unknown alien worlds, feel THAT combat rush, meet your first enemies, your ship, and most of all, unleash the raw, unconventional abilities of your player and drone.


Time to slice monsters, test your skills, and build your AI into the deadliest machine in the system.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/0b897ce741b2a05231864809b421a57fa58dcc24.png"]


Meet the Ship. And Your Enemies.


Welcome aboard your damaged spaceship.
Your AI just booted up — and its first move, in the form of SYNR (Synthetic Runner), is heading straight toward a planet swarming with merciless enemies.
Get a taste of hostile lifeforms that won't care who you are, just how fast you die. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665697/38f0d94822873a9de5eeee96447135b8967e4fd9.png"]


Combat in the Void – try Playtest 0.1, and you’ll be eagerly waiting for the next update.


Test fast, twitchy combat full of dodging, slicing, and raw precision.
Mix high-impact melee with devastating drone strikes, and experiment with your first build paths.
Explore your first unforgiving planets, soak in the atmosphere, and feel how core movement and combat mechanics come together.




We want to hear from you!


What did you think of your first drop? Not bad, huh? Got thoughts on combat tempo, the feel of movement, or how the drone handles?
Your feedback moves us forward, so 👉 join our Discord and drop us a message about what hit just right. We're there. And yes, we’re reading it.




Wishlist = your weapon against forgetfulness


We hope you enjoy the game as much as we love making it. If you don’t want to miss what’s coming next — stay tuned and don’t forget to add Stellar Destiny to your wishlist on Steam to stay locked in.



Thanks for playing,
Your dev team | Stellar Destiny: The Last Survivor
